从文件树打开一个 pdf 文件。: Open a PDF file from the file tree.
单击 pdf 开真阅读器——渲染、翻页、缩放、搜索；卸载即退回。: Click a PDF to open a real reader — render, page through, zoom, search; uninstall to revert.

读不到「{{name}}」——文件可能已被移走，或被别的程序占用。: Couldn't read "{{name}}" — the file may have been moved or is locked by another program.
在市场搜索阅读器: Search the marketplace for a reader
打开 PDF 时的初始缩放档；你手动缩放过后本次阅读不再跟随它。: Initial zoom mode when opening a PDF; once you zoom manually, this session no longer follows it.
往后翻一页（等于工具栏的下一页钮与键盘 PageDown）。已在最后一页时如实回: Go to the next page (same as the toolbar next button and PageDown). On the last page it returns noop honestly instead of pretending to advance. Returns { ok, sourceId, field:"currentPage", previous, value, numPages }. Requires an open PDF (no-document when none is attached).
往前翻一页（等于工具栏的上一页钮与键盘 PageUp）。已在第一页时如实回 no: Go to the previous page (same as the toolbar previous button and PageUp). On the first page it returns noop honestly. Returns the same shape as pdf-reader.pageNext.
跳到指定页（等于页码框回车；页码 1-based，从 1 起不是下标）。越界或非: Jump to a page (same as pressing Enter in the page box; pages are 1-based, not zero-based indices). Out-of-range or non-integer values return ok:false with reason=out-of-range|bad-page (including the page count). Returns { ok, sourceId, field:"currentPage", previous, value, numPages }.
放大一档（×1.2，范围 25%–400%）。已在上限回 noop ＋ reas: Zoom in one step (×1.2, range 25%–400%). At the upper limit it returns noop with reason=at-max-zoom. Returns { ok, sourceId, field:"scale", previous, value, zoomMode }; scale is a multiplier (1 = 100%).
缩小一档（÷1.2，范围 25%–400%）。已在下限回 noop ＋ reas: Zoom out one step (÷1.2, range 25%–400%). At the lower limit it returns noop with reason=at-min-zoom. Returns the same shape as pdf-reader.zoomIn.
把缩放设成指定倍率（1 = 100%，范围 0.25–4.0）——工具栏「点击回: Set an exact zoom multiplier (1 = 100%, range 0.25–4.0)—the general form of the toolbar's "click to return to 100%" action (pass { "scale": 1 }). Out-of-range values return ok:false with reason=out-of-range|bad-scale. Returns { ok, sourceId, field:"scale", previous, value, zoomMode }.
缩放档切成适宽（页宽铺满阅读区，随窗口尺寸变化重算）。本来就是适宽则回 noop: Switch zoom mode to fit-width (page width fills the reading area and recalculates on resize). If already fit-width, returns noop with reason=already-fit-width. Returns { ok, sourceId, field:"zoomMode", previous, value, scale }.
缩放档切成适页（整页可见，随窗口尺寸变化重算）。本来就是适页则回 noop ＋: Switch zoom mode to fit-page (the whole page is visible and recalculates on resize). If already fit-page, returns noop with reason=already-fit-page. Returns the same shape as pdf-reader.fitWidth.
设置阅读区底色：paper=纸白 ／ night=夜间（阅读区不跟壳主题，是用户: Set the reading background: paper = paper white / night = night mode (the reading area deliberately does not follow the shell theme). Invalid values return ok:false with reason=bad-bg; already in that mode returns noop. Returns { ok, sourceId, field:"bg", previous, value }.
开关左侧缩略图侧栏（等于工具栏最左那颗钮）。回执带翻转**之后读回**的值 {: Toggle the left thumbnail sidebar (same as the leftmost toolbar button). The result carries the value read back after the toggle: { ok, sourceId, field:"sidebarOpen", previous, value }—never infer state from the command title. Requires an open PDF.
展开阅读区顶上的搜索条（等于工具栏的放大镜钮）。幂等：本来就开着如实回 noop: Open the search bar at the top of the reading area (same as the magnifier button). Idempotent: already open returns noop with reason=already-open, not a failure. It only opens the bar—close it with its own ✕ or Esc (there is no separate toggle command). This command does not type a query: search is typing-driven; to inspect results, call pdf-reader.getStatus and read searchQuery/searchHits/searchCurrent/searchScanning. Returns { ok, sourceId, field:"searchOpen", previous, value }. Requires an open PDF.
读当前阅读器的结构化状态——与状态条同源一份数据（当前页/总页数/倍率/缩放档/: Read the reader's structured state—the same data as the status bar (current page/total pages/scale/zoom mode/background/sidebar and outline/search). Returns { ok, sourceId, hasDocument, currentPage, numPages, scale, zoomMode, bg, sidebarOpen, outlineCount, searchOpen, searchQuery, searchHits, searchCurrent, searchScanning, searchScannedPages, phase }; searchCurrent is the 1-based hit index (0 = no current hit), and when searchScanning is true, searchScannedPages is the number of pages scanned; outlineCount is the total outline entry count including children (0 = no outline, not a failure). With no PDF open it still succeeds: ok:true + hasDocument:false + phase="none" (empty ≠ failure); only a named source that cannot be found returns ok:false + reason=bad-source (listing available sources).
